# Synthetic cache controller -- a fixture, not a real design

The controller idles until a request arrives.

REQ-A. On a request with a tag miss, the controller enters the LREFILL3 state
and asserts burst.

REQ-B. While in the line-refill state, the controller must not accept a second
request.

REQ-C. The controller leaves the state it occupies while the cache line is
being refilled once the fourth word has been acknowledged.

REQ-D. The store-refill path is present only when OR1200_DC_STORE_REFILL is
defined; on this build it is absent.

REQ-E. The write-back buffer holds the address most recently accepted, and this
address appears on saved_addr.

REQ-F. The controller supports a delayed-write mode governed by
OR1200_DC_WRITETHROUGH, whose behaviour is described elsewhere.
